name: Beverly Center
summary: High-end shopping mall offers luxury designer shops, well-known department stores & restaurants.
description: Beverly Center is an iconic eight-story shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring a distinctive contemporary design and a curated mix of fashion-forward retailers. Located at the intersection of Beverly Boulevard and La Cienega, this premier shopping center offers an elevated retail experience with both established luxury brands and contemporary fashion favorites.
demographics: Beverly Center attracts an affluent, fashion-conscious demographic with visitors typically ranging from 25-54 years old and household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area encompasses West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and nearby affluent Los Angeles neighborhoods, drawing shoppers seeking contemporary fashion and luxury goods. The center's visitors are predominantly urban professionals and style-forward consumers who value curated shopping experiences, trending brands, and the convenience of a centralized luxury retail destination in the heart of LA's prestigious Westside.
